about_blocks.text: Dr. Saira Athar is a community based family physician and has expressed an interest in the community and is giving one day a week of her time for primary care for all members of the community. She sees patients every Wednesday from 9:00 am – 12noon at the Health Centre and patients at the Wik-Chiplakon, by appointments only. Appointments can be made by calling Amanda at the front desk 363-4001. Dr. Athar has been with us for almost a year. We are very fortunate to have this opportunity as many of us lack a family physician. sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
